post.title: [Hiring] React developer for an internal admin dashboard - $800
post.body:
We run a small recruiting agency and need an admin dashboard on top of our existing REST API. Tables with filters, a candidate detail page, and CSV export. The API is documented in Swagger.

Budget: $800 fixed.
Timeline: about 2 weeks, we are not in a rush.
Please send a link to something similar you built.

analysis.summary: Build a React admin dashboard (tables, filters, detail page, CSV export) on an existing REST API for a recruiting agency.

expect: mentions the dashboard or the filters/CSV export
links only the project link from the evidence
does not mention a rate (budget fits, but not needed in public comment)
